lead: Dominated by full-year results from Perseus Mining and Ora Banda Mining, both posting record FY26 profits on strong gold prices, alongside Ora Banda's new FY27 guidance of 125,000oz to 140,000oz gold production at AISC of A$3,400/oz to A$3,600/oz, a step down from FY26's 141,000oz output.
subtitle: Record profits and new production guidance from Perseus and Ora Banda set the tone, with high-grade drill hits at Torque and Gateway underscoring the sector's exploration momentum.
subject: OBM sets FY27 guidance 125-140koz, PRU FY26 profit up 14% to $480.5M
watch_items: Matsa Resources suspended from quotation until the earlier of its Devon Pit Gold Project announcement or the start of trading on 31 August 2026
Torque's Ritz Gold Project (HHH deposit) has two rigs continuing to drill after a 456g/t Au intercept, with follow-up results awaited
Gateway's RC drilling continues at Cowza, with initial assay results due next month
Perseus Mining is considering a further A$100 million distribution from Meyas Sand sale proceeds, with Nyanzaga first gold targeted for January 2027
day_in_brief:
Corporate results: Perseus Mining reported FY26 profit after tax of $480.5 million (up 14%) on revenue of $1.484 billion and EBITDA of $860.5 million, lifting its full-year dividend 87% to a record 14 A$cps and launching a new A$350 million buyback after completing A$126 million of purchases. Ora Banda Mining posted record FY26 revenue of $807.5 million (up from $404.3 million), EBITDA up 134% to $431.1 million and NPAT up 16% to $216.2 million, with gold sold rising to 140,641oz as the Sand King Underground mine reached commercial production and paid back capital within 12 months.

Guidance: Ora Banda's FY27 guidance calls for 125,000oz to 140,000oz gold production at AISC of A$3,400/oz to A$3,600/oz and growth capex of A$425 million, building on FY26 closing cash of $267.7 million and total liquidity above $468 million after upsizing its revolving credit facility to $200 million.

Drilling: Torque's extensional RC drilling at the HHH deposit within the newly renamed Ritz Gold Project returned 11.0m @ 456g/t Au from 122m including 1.0m @ 3,625g/t Au with abundant visible gold, while a follow-up diamond hole added 7.9m @ 1.37g/t Au from 146.2m to support a down-dip extension. Gateway extended the Cowza strike a further 1km to approximately 4.5km with step-out intercepts including 8m @ 2.1g/t Au from 84m and 8m @ 1.6g/t Au from 80m, plus a new high-grade shoot at Celia South of 4m @ 9.7g/t Au from 60m.

Corporate and governance: PC Gold appointed mine-builders Rick Clark and Matthew Scully as Non-Executive Directors ahead of a Prefeasibility Study for a 3Mtpa CIL plant at Spring Hill, while two directors stepped down. Bellevue Gold will add Debra Counsell and Tanya Rybarczyk as Independent Non-Executive Directors from 23 September 2026, with Shannon Coates not standing for re-election, and Predictive Discovery formalised its name change to PDI Gold Limited via a new constitution.

Other: Matsa Resources voluntarily suspended trading from 26 August 2026 pending an announcement on the Devon Pit Gold Project, with suspension to lift by the earlier of the announcement's release or 31 August 2026. Perseus also lodged its FY26 Sustainable Development Report, showing US$1.19 billion in economic value distributed to host countries (up from US$813 million) and improved safety and emissions metrics.

summaries.heading: PC Gold appoints mine-builders Clark and Scully to board
summaries.body: PC Gold has appointed Rick Clark, former Red Back Mining CEO (sold to Kinross for US$7.1 billion), and Matthew Scully, a project director with over 20 years building mines for Perseus Mining and West African Resources, as Non-Executive Directors. Non-Executive Directors John Menzies and John Lewis have stepped down. The moves support the Prefeasibility Study underway for a 3Mtpa CIL plant at the 100%-owned Spring Hill Gold Project in the Northern Territory.

summaries.heading: Perseus posts record profit, lifts dividend 87% on strong gold prices
summaries.body: Perseus Mining reported FY26 profit after tax of $480.5 million, up 14%, on revenue of $1.484 billion and EBITDA of $860.5 million. The board declared a 9.0 A$cps final dividend, taking the full year payout to a record 14 A$cps, up 87%, alongside completion of A$126 million of buybacks and a new A$350 million buyback programme. A further A$100 million distribution from the Meyas Sand sale proceeds is being considered, with Nyanzaga on track for first gold in January 2027.

summaries.heading: Cowza strike grows to 4.5km, Celia South high-grade shoot found
summaries.body: Gateway's aircore drilling has extended continuous high-grade gold mineralisation at Cowza by a further 1km to approximately 4.5km, remaining open along strike and at depth. New step-out intercepts include 8m @ 2.1g/t Au from 84m (CSAC0066) and 8m @ 1.6g/t Au from 80m (CSAC0073), while Celia South returned 4m @ 9.7g/t Au from 60m (CSAC0101) across 1.5km of strike. RC drilling is ongoing at Cowza, with initial assay results due next month.

summaries.heading: Perseus lifts economic distribution to host nations in FY26 report
summaries.body: Perseus Mining's FY26 Sustainable Development Report shows US$1.19 billion in economic value distributed to host countries, up from US$813 million in FY25. Group TRIFR was 0.91 with zero lost time injuries across all operations. Emissions intensity improved to 0.52tCO2-e/oz from 0.56tCO2-e/oz in FY25, and 208.68ha of disturbed land was rehabilitated across five waste dump sites.

summaries.heading: Torque hits multi-ounce visible gold intercept at HHH
summaries.body: Extensional RC drilling at the HHH deposit within Torque's newly renamed Ritz Gold Project has returned 11.0m @ 456g/t Au from 122m in hole 26HRC135, including 1.0m @ 3,625g/t Au, with abundant visible gold observed in drill chips. Follow-up diamond hole 26HDD012 returned 7.9m @ 1.37g/t Au from 146.2m, supporting a down-dip extension. HHH currently hosts a 73,000oz Inferred and Indicated resource at 2.0g/t Au, with two rigs continuing to drill across the project.

summaries.heading: Predictive Discovery adopts new constitution as PDI Gold
summaries.body: Predictive Discovery Limited has lodged its new constitution as PDI Gold Limited, approved by shareholders at the General Meeting held on 21 August 2026. The document formalises the company's name change and standard governance provisions covering share capital, meetings, directors and winding up. No operational or financial details were included.

summaries.heading: Matsa voluntarily suspended ahead of Devon Pit announcement
summaries.body: Matsa Resources has been suspended from quotation under Listing Rule 17.2 at its own request, effective before trading on 26 August 2026, to finalise an announcement on the Devon Pit Gold Project. Suspension continues until the earlier of the announcement's release or the start of trading on 31 August 2026.

summaries.heading: Ora Banda posts record FY26 profit on Sand King ramp-up
summaries.body: Ora Banda Mining reported record FY26 revenue of $807.5 million, up from $404.3 million, with EBITDA up 134% to $431.1 million and NPAT up 16% to $216.2 million. Gold sold rose to 140,641oz (FY25: 93,076oz) as the Sand King Underground mine reached commercial production and achieved capital payback within 12 months of portal establishment. Closing cash reached $267.7 million, with an upsized $200 million revolving credit facility providing more than $468 million in total liquidity.

summaries.heading: Bellevue appoints two independent non-executive directors
summaries.body: Bellevue Gold will appoint Debra Counsell and Tanya Rybarczyk as Independent Non-Executive Directors effective 23 September 2026, part of previously flagged board succession planning. Counsell was Chief Legal Officer and Company Secretary at BlueScope Steel, while Rybarczyk spent over 20 years at Wesfarmers including as CFO of WesCEF. Shannon Coates will not stand for re-election at this year's AGM.

other.headline: Corporate Governance Statement
other.summary: Perseus Mining lodges its 2026 Corporate Governance Statement, noting one instance where it does not meet an ASX Principles recommendation and disclosing workforce gender diversity of 11.4% across the group (Board 25%, Executive Leadership Team 40%), with no production, cost, cash or financial figures included.

other.headline: 2026 Annual Report
other.summary: Ora Banda Mining set FY27 guidance of 125-140koz gold production at AISC of A$3,400/oz to A$3,600/oz and growth capex of A$425 million, after FY26 record production of 141koz gold (up 53% on FY25) with Davyhurst throughput of 1.26Mt (up 19%) at 92% recovery. The company closed FY26 with A$267.7 million cash (up A$183.5 million on FY25's A$84.2 million), total liquidity above A$468 million after upsizing its revolving credit facility to A$200 million, and reported record revenue of A$807.5 million (up 100%), EBITDA of A$431.1 million (up 134%), net profit after tax of A$216.2 million (up 16%) and earnings per share of 10.89 cents (up 7%), after investing A$236 million in development and growth initiatives.

other.headline: FY26 Corporate Governance Statement
other.summary: Ora Banda Mining's FY26 Corporate Governance Statement covers board and governance policy matters only, with no production, cost, cash, revenue, profit or dividend figures disclosed.

other.headline: Appendix 4E
other.summary: Ora Banda Mining reported FY26 revenue up 99.7% to A$807.5 million and net profit after tax up 16.2% to A$216.2 million, with net tangible assets per share rising to $0.28 from $0.15; no dividend was declared for the year.
